description.id: Datang ke masjid dengan pakaian pantas dan tubuh yang bersih.
description.en: Come to the mosque in appropriate clothing and with personal cleanliness.

description.id: Jaga suara dan perilaku agar tidak mengganggu ibadah atau pembelajaran orang lain.
description.en: Keep voice and conduct from disrupting others' worship or learning.

description.id: Gunakan masjid untuk ibadah, mengingat Allah, dan kegiatan baik sesuai pengelolaannya.
description.en: Use the mosque for worship, remembrance of God, and beneficial activities under its governance.

description.id: Jaga kesucian dan kebersihan ruang, fasilitas, serta lingkungan masjid.
description.en: Preserve the purity and cleanliness of mosque spaces, facilities, and surroundings.

description.id: Hormati jamaah, antrean, ruang bersama, aksesibilitas, dan aturan pengelola yang tidak bertentangan dengan agama.
description.en: Respect worshippers, queues, shared spaces, accessibility, and management rules that do not conflict with religion.
